Notice of Long-term Rerouting

Due to the Market Street Bridge Rehabilitation project, this bus has been rerouted until August 2027. The route you see in the digital tools has been updated to reflect this information. For more information, visit septa.org/news/market-street-detours.

Sunday Schedule in Effect for Thanksgiving Day

Bus, Metro and Regional Rail routes operate on a Sunday schedule on Thanksgiving Day. Routes that do not have Sunday schedules do not operate. All modes resume regular weekday schedule at the start of service day, Friday, November 27.
